text:
maria: Heads up — customer X signed final contract but wants quota increase active before the deadline (EOD Fri). Can we make a scoped policy change to bump reserved pool by 15% for their org id?
ajay: do we have headroom in regional pools? quick check shows APAC is tight but us-west+eu have slack.
lucy: oncall queue shows sustained 95th p99 close to SLA in us-west yesterday, pushing more there could hurt latency.
ken: sales says customer will push launch if we don't meet the commit. They already have a trial in prod hitting rate limits.
maria: proposal: temporary burst allowance for customer X routed to eu + us-west but capped per-minute and auto-revoked after 7 days. No code changes.
ajay: sounds reasonable. Need an ops-approved rollback plan. Also need to ensure autoscale policies don't immediately spin extra GPUs in APAC.
lucy: agree. I can add a regional routing rule: prefer eu for their traffic, fallback to us-west, block apac. Also add a soft cap throttle at 200 requests/min for the org id.
maria: can you paste the config snippet you'll apply?
lucy: sure —
```json
{"route_rules": [{"org_id": "org-X","preferred_regions": ["eu","us-west"],"max_rps": 3.3}],"burst_allowance": {"org_id":"org-X","extra_tokens": 150000}}
```
ajay: for autoscale, set a policy exclusion tag so their traffic doesn't trigger preemptive scale that would be billed as reserved. Something like `no-autoscale-trigger: org-X-burst`
deply-bot: (deployment pipeline) new config pr created by lucy:refs/changes/1234 — awaiting approvals.
ken: legal ok with 7-day temporary uplift? they asked for 14 originally.
maria: legal said 7 is fine for this pilot. If it works we talk long-term quota bump.
ajay: operational checklist: 1) feature flag rollout to route rule, 2) observe p90/p99 latency 10m windows, 3) set alert if error rate >1% or latency spike >40%.
lucy: will add alerts to oncall: monitor org-X errors and per-region GPU utilization.
maria: launch criteria for this uplift: toggled route + throttles in place, alerts wired, rollback PR approved, sales readiness.
ken: sales ready. If we get the PR approved by noon tomorrow we can toggle at 18:00 and monitor over evening.
ajay: pinging infra for quick approval — @infra-team-approvals can we expedite?
deploy-bot: infra-approvals requested for change 1234 by lucy.
lucy: small detail — we need to ensure billing meter doesn't double-count burst tokens; finance confirmed the temporary tokens will be attributed to customer X as usage, not a separate reserved charge.
maria: ok good. any objections?
ajay: none from eng, as long as rollback automated.
lucy: none. I'll make the PR add an auto-revoke timestamp and run a canary for 30 minutes before full toggle.
ken: customer is ok with canary. they asked for low-latency window tonight but can wait for canary.
maria: final action items: lucy create PR with route+throttle+auto-revoke (in flight), ajay add autoscale-exempt tag + rollback playbook, ops to approve, legal/finance confirmed. I'll update the customer timeline.
lucy: PR created: https://git.internal/r/changes/1234. canary schedule in PR description.
ajay: approved in prod config review. marking onboarded.
maria: thanks team — keeping this thread as launch record. will follow up EOD Friday for metrics. :thumbsup:
